item.tib: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen mo'i rgyud las dbang byang gsal ba'i sgron me
item.coloph: zhi khro bar do thos chog rang grol gyi/ dbang gi las byang gsal byed sgron ma 'di/ gang zhig spros med spros pa'i rjes 'brangs shing / shes chung dad ldan rnams kyi blo yi ngor/ gang 'dul snang ba'i gzugs brnyan bkod pa ltar/ 'di ni thos chung kun grags ming gis brtsams/ dge ba'i bstan 'gro phan bder 'byed nus shog/
